item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Portrait From a Seventies Film

turns.text: Make this look like a still from a 1970s movie—warm faded colours and film grain. Keep her recognisable and keep the square framing. No text.

item.tests: Applies a convincing 1970s film treatment while preserving the uploaded portrait's identity and composition.

answer_sheet.Style and mood: A nostalgic 1970s colour film still, with warm faded colours and visible film grain.
answer_sheet.What to preserve: Her identity, curly dark hair, sweater, pose and park setting.
answer_sheet.Size and format: One square image; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: The woman remains recognisable as the woman in the source portrait.
Her curly dark hair, sweater and head-and-shoulders framing are retained.
The park background remains identifiable rather than becoming a different setting.
Warm, faded colour grading and visible film grain give the image a 1970s film-still appearance.
The output is square and contains no added text.

turns.text: make a pic from this pic

dialog.agent:
Happy to help. Before I start, I need to know one thing:

**What should change in the picture?**

For example, you could put her somewhere else like a beach, a city or a studio. You could turn it into a cartoon, anime or oil painting, change her clothes or hair, or make it a professional headshot. Anything else works too.
dialog.why: The assistant asks the user what change they want made to the picture and waits for an answer before it does anything.
dialog.user: make it look like an old 70s movie, like warm faded colors and grainy

turns.agent:
I couldn't make the picture. Your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits for this edit, so nothing was created.

I used the cheapest option your free plan has (Flux 2 Klein, small 640px size, one image), so a different setting won't get around it. To go ahead, you'd need more credits: either wait for your free credits to refill, or buy a credit pack or upgrade on magichour.ai.

When you have credits again, just tell me and I'll make it with the look you asked for. It'll be the same woman, curly hair, grey sweater and park, but restyled like a 1970s movie still with warm, faded colours and film grain.
